objective: Recover verifiably available vacancy fields from existing public source adapters before eligibility decisions, preserving source provenance and production isolation.
allowed_changes: Correct demonstrated omissions and incorrect extraction of existing public source data and metadata
Use existing detail endpoints and cache with bounded zero-paid-API enrichment before final eligibility filtering
Preserve source-provided structured fields and provenance without inferring missing values
Distinguish origin absent, pending retrieval, extraction failure and recovered metadata through existing UI and response shapes
Verify real-source before-and-after coverage, performance and regression tests
forbidden_changes: main branch, production deployment, production database writes or shared cache writes during tests
new job engines, schedulers, database tables, paid services, or paid APIs
CV engine, scoring formulas, user profile, candidate history, applications or authentication
inventing publication dates, geography, modality, salaries or other absent source fields
GitHub Actions, Vercel, mock data in production or automatic job applications
acceptance: Real source samples prove that recoverable fields are recovered before classification
Fields truly absent remain unknown with provenance and no false positives
Relevant tests and scoped diff checks pass
Isolated canary UI loads against the tested backend with no changes to main or production Neon
Human homologation link and before-and-after evidence delivered before merge
deployment: Isolated canary only; main merge requires separate explicit user approval
